## Objective and scope

Choose and version a single acquired-T1 parameter and stopping policy using bounded development experiments, without consuming qualification outcomes.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Use subject-separated development folds and cohort-level summaries; retain per-structure and worst-case/tail outcomes and predeclared selection rules.
2. Demonstrate anatomical improvement over the previous selected HalfFlow recipe on the development panel, including the documented difficult cases, while every exported result satisfies unchanged geometry/inverse requirements.
3. Choose image-only convergence and rollback/failure behavior; no label-selected checkpoints or per-pair hand tuning. Distinguish full nonlinear convergence from coarse-only/stalled/fallback results.
4. Pin objective, physical scales, regularization, controller limits, preprocessing, affine policy and failure rules in a versioned receipt. If no candidate qualifies, record the negative result and leave G4/R01 unresolved.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/
- benchmarks/flashalign/receipts/
- docs/benchmarks/

## Blocking prerequisites

- A01 (`bd-01M4X4DZ2RBKVMK1H8MEPYGW0B`)
- P02 (`bd-01M4X4DXW7WGW5WK0J3Z6PFP98`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.
